sources.title: NIST-JANAF S5(g), table S-018
sources.access: Official HTML table inspected; eight selected nodes transcribed. Underlying printed evaluation notes not obtained.
findings: Four frozen H/S/Gf nodes and the Hf298 anchor agree with official HTML.
At 298.15 K the printed free-energy function is 477.413 while S is 308.638 J/mol/K and H-H298=0. Preserve this inconsistent source entry; do not feed it into H/S reconstruction.
The inspected table supplies no values below 298.15 K; no 0 K extrapolation is made.

sources.title: NASA Glenn coefficients for calculating thermodynamic properties of individual species
sources.access: Full public report downloaded; Appendix D printed page 184 (PDF page 192) visually checked. Selected S5 record archived; full report uncommitted.
findings: All 18 S5 coefficients match the frozen baseline.
The record cites Gurvich 1989, part 1 page 281 and part 2 page 169.
Appendix B gives Hf298=132.993 kJ/mol, S298=354.086 J/mol/K and Cp298=87.870 J/mol/K; the precise Appendix D header Hf298 is 132.993354 kJ/mol.
The header H298-H0=19.053354 kJ/mol is a thermal increment. Molecular Hf(0) and the H(0) gauge are different quantities.

sources.title: Thermodynamics of sulphur vapour
sources.authors: H. Rau, T. R. N. Kutty, J. R. F. Guedes de Carvalho
sources.access: Publisher abstract and metadata inspected in web search; full text not obtained.
findings: The abstract reports sulfur-vapor density measurements at 823-1273 K up to saturation and a model giving S2-S8 partial pressures with real-gas corrections.
This is a mixture thermodynamic reduction, not a separately observed S5 rovibrational inventory. Its stated temperature range does not validate 1500-4000 K.
sources.needed: S5-specific input assumptions, fitted thermochemical quantities, uncertainty and correlations with other sulfur clusters.

sources.title: A universal chemical potential for sulfur vapours
sources.authors: A. J. Jackson, D. Tiana, A. Walsh
sources.access: Full public author manuscript downloaded and relevant sections inspected; publisher page returned 403. No full article committed.
findings: The authors describe JANAF S3-S7 values as derived from empirical interpolation of Rau sulfur-vapor data; this genealogy is their account, not a newly verified reading of the 1977 notes.
The S5 search yields a five-membered Cs ring as its principal candidate.
The model uses DFT energies with rigid-rotor/harmonic thermodynamics; frequencies are empirically calibrated and an experimental S8 sublimation enthalpy sets the alpha-sulfur reference.
The mixture chemical potential includes several S2-S8 species/isomers. It is not the single-species standard chemical potential required for the S5 record.
The study provides a useful independent candidate route, not validated individual S5 thermochemistry over the full curated 1500-4000 K domain.
sources.candidate_resources_access: Links identified from the manuscript; full computational datasets were not ingested or independently reproduced.
